descriptions.reviews_tab_button: Reviews tab in Google Maps listing sidebar
descriptions.review_item: Individual review card element (seed for parser locator tier 5)
descriptions.review_id_attr: HTML attribute holding the unique review ID (data-review-id)
descriptions.reviewer_name_attr: HTML attribute holding the reviewer display name
descriptions.review_text_selector: CSS selector for review text content span
descriptions.rating_selector: CSS selector for star rating element
descriptions.rating_attr: HTML attribute holding numeric star rating value
descriptions.relative_date_selector: CSS selector for relative date text (e.g. '2 weeks ago')
descriptions.expand_text_button: Expand/See-more button on truncated review cards

fallback_notes.cookie_reject_button: Google may serve variant banner text or layout by locale — primary selector covers EN 'Reject all'; first fallback uses has-text which is more resilient to wrapper changes
fallback_notes.reviews_tab_button: aria-label may vary by locale (Reviews/Avis/Recensioni) — first fallback covers French, second uses role=tab for broader DOM matching
fallback_notes.review_container: Primary is the 2023-vintage CSS class triple; first fallback uses role=feed (more semantic, less likely to change across redesigns); second fallback uses role=region within a known parent class
fallback_notes.expand_text_button: Primary targets known class; fallbacks use text content matching as the W3C accessibility tree approach recommends
